data.long_meaning: The name Merrilee is derived from the Anglo-Saxon words 'mearg' meaning 'bright, shining' and 'leah' meaning 'meadow' or 'open woodland'. This name conveys the idea of a bright, cheerful, and joyful person, living in a beautiful and open environment. The name Merrilee carries the meaning “MERRY LEA, HAPPY MEADOW” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Merrilee usually hope their child will grow to embody merry lea, happy meadow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
